channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Trump signs executive order easing federal restrictions on marijuana
item.description: The executive order reclassifies marijuana as a Schedule III drug, easing the path for more research.

item.title: I've been to dozens of airport lounges worldwide. Here are the 5 things I never do in them.
item.description: As a frequent flyer, there are things I'd never do in an airport lounge, such as sleeping or stuffing my face at the buffet.

item.title: House Democrats share new Epstein photos featuring Sergey Brin and Bill Gates
item.description: Democrats on the House Oversight Committee released new photos from Jeffrey Epstein's estate, including some showing him with powerful people.

item.title: The Coldplay 'kiss cam' video exposed the internet's darkest impulses
item.description: The Coldplay "kiss cam" led to harassment for Kristin Cabot, the woman in the video, she says. That should make us all feel bad about the internet.

item.title: Erebor Bank, Palmer Luckey's crypto-oriented finance startup, just got one step closer to launching
item.description: The FDIC approved the bank's application on Dec 16. It still requires final approval from the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.

item.title: TikTok reaches a deal with investors on its US business
item.description: The deal comes more than a year after Congress passed a law that forced its owner ByteDance to divest its US operations or face a ban.

item.title: Ukraine is building nearly 1,000 specialized drones a day to counter Russia's Iranian Shaheds
item.description: In the last year, Ukraine's interceptors have gone from novel technology to being produced in the thousands every month.

item.title: Sam Altman says OpenAI has gone 'code red' multiple times — and they'll do it again
item.description: Sam Altman said OpenAI has entered "code red" mode multiple times to respond to competitive AI threats — and they'll do it again.

item.title: Robert Irwin says his mom held the family together after his father died
item.description: Robert Irwin said his "Dancing With the Stars" tribute was for his mom and "all the single parents" whose efforts aren't always recognized.

item.title: Putin's annual Q&A with Russians is back. 2 issues are front and center.
item.description: The anxiety comes as Russia's inflation remains high, and the country's massive defense spending jostles with social spending.
